executionArgs.additionalInstruction: Login credentials: username=admin, password=123456. The app is a single HTML file SPA (raya_odoo.html). Navigation is done by clicking sidebar .nav-item elements which call go(). After login, verify the dashboard is visible (#app display block, #login-screen hidden). To navigate to inventory (spare parts), click the nav-item that calls go('inv-parts'). Then click the tab button for 'الأصناف' (items tab) and verify rows appear in #inv-items-body. The app is RTL Arabic.
